headline: BNP's Mirza Faisal wins Thakurgaon-1 by-election by over 131,000 votes
summary: Mirza Faisal Amin of BNP secured a landslide victory in the Thakurgaon-1 by-election, defeating his closest rival by a significant margin. The Election Commission reported the process was peaceful.
details: BNP candidate Mirza Faisal Amin has won the Thakurgaon-1 by-election, defeating his closest rival, Jamaat-e-Islami candidate Delawar Hosen, by 131,336 votes. The results were declared by Returning Officer and Thakurgaon District Election Officer Kamrul Islam around 9:30 PM on Thursday.
Faisal, who is the younger brother of BNP Secretary General Mirza Fakhrul Islam Alamgir, garnered 227,789 votes. His opponent, Delawar Hosen, secured 96,453 votes.

Election and administrative officials from various levels of the district were present during the announcement of the results. The Election Commission expressed satisfaction with the peaceful conduct of the by-election.
caption:
BNP candidate Mirza Faisal Amin wins Thakurgaon-1 by-election by a margin of 131,336 votes.

BNP candidate Mirza Faisal Amin has won the Thakurgaon-1 by-election, defeating his closest rival, Jamaat-e-Islami candidate Delawar Hosen, by 131,336 votes. The results were declared by Returning Officer and Thakurgaon District Election Officer Kamrul Islam around 9:30 PM on Thursday.

Faisal, who is the younger brother of BNP Secretary General Mirza Fakhrul Islam Alamgir, garnered 227,789 votes. His opponent, Delawar Hosen, secured 96,453 votes.

Election and administrative officials from various levels of the district were present during the announcement of the results. The Election Commission expressed satisfaction with the peaceful conduct of the by-election.

headline_marked: Ex-BAF officer's [[body recovered from Turag river]]
headline: Ex-BAF officer's body recovered from Turag river
summary: Former Flight Lieutenant Tahsif Souri, who reportedly recorded the video of ousted PM Sheikh Hasina leaving the country, has been found dead.
details: The body of former Bangladesh Air Force Flight Lieutenant Tahsif Souri was recovered from the Turag river near Rajabari Ghat in Uttarkhan yesterday.
A witness, Khokon Mia, reported seeing the body floating downstream before it became lodged against a moored speedboat for several hours.
Tongs River Police recovered the body around 4:30 PM after receiving a call via the national emergency helpline 999.
Tahsif Souri had gained attention for reportedly recording the footage of ousted Prime Minister Sheikh Hasina leaving Bangladesh on August 5, 2024.
Police found an iPhone and a wristwatch on the body, which helped in the identification process.
The body has been sent to the morgue of Shaheed Suhrawardy Medical College for an autopsy to determine the cause of death.
While police conduct their investigation, Tahsif's father has claimed that his son was murdered.
caption:
The man who reportedly recorded the video of Sheikh Hasina's departure from Bangladesh has been found dead in the Turag river.

The body of former Bangladesh Air Force Flight Lieutenant Tahsif Souri was recovered from the Turag river near Rajabari Ghat in Uttarkhan yesterday.

A witness, Khokon Mia, reported seeing the body floating downstream before it became lodged against a moored speedboat for several hours.

Tongs River Police recovered the body around 4:30 PM after receiving a call via the national emergency helpline 999.

Tahsif Souri had gained attention for reportedly recording the footage of ousted Prime Minister Sheikh Hasina leaving Bangladesh on August 5, 2024.

Police found an iPhone and a wristwatch on the body, which helped in the identification process.

The body has been sent to the morgue of Shaheed Suhrawardy Medical College for an autopsy to determine the cause of death.

While police conduct their investigation, Tahsif's father has claimed that his son was murdered.
